purpose: Localize the repeated functional preservation symptoms without assuming irreversible write damage or a need for shared controllers.
gate: Require complete independently audited576-answer replica and report both primary outcomes first. Execute this diagnostic only if at least one primary recurs on at least two distinct new streams. No method training follows automatically.
reader_policy: full except separately labeled oracle-history controls
members: Every base stream and every value version in each stratum, whether correct or wrong in discovery/replication. Each dataset has16 pairs per stratum and48 pair/role units; do not select only errors.
source_prefixes: Construct each natural source from ledger tokens only, including the two tail records and excluding every question/answer token. Paired sources differ only at the registered three value digits. Verify equal lengths, query suffixes, gold answers and complete cache bookkeeping.
swap_scope: All18 GDN recurrent states and their18 convolution caches versus all six Attention KV layers. Clone source tensors and preserve/validate all required cache metadata. No resetting, omitting convolution state, future tokens or source mutation.
readouts: Use cached-question processing for every primary condition, unrestricted greedy maximum12 tokens and gold3-digit NLL. Compare both cached natural endpoints with their stored full-prefill observations instead of assuming BF16 full/cached equivalence.
controls: On the minimum/maximum pair identity in each dataset/stratum, replay both self-source and both all-path donor clones, with exact cache/metadata and cached-logit/NLL agreement. Observe actual cached historical access at all six Attention layers. Check source-cache immutability and loaded model-state hash/freeze before and after. Report physical prefills and repeated-prefix fingerprints if sources are recomputed.
oracle_history_control: For each natural source, preserve its entire ledger computation and historical recurrent/conv/KV tensors, but at question time expose only instruction tokens and the exact supporting record: index1 for B-current, index0 for A-initial. Keep question/answer causality. Verify sampled native pre-question prefix identity and actual question-time probabilities. Report every oracle result, including failures, without calling oracle recovery proof that recurrent damage is absent.
reports: All strata, source combinations and individual paired transitions; cached-vs-full calibration; role-specific NLL effects and difference-in-differences; complete value/base-stream counts; all oracle controls. Discovery and replica remain separate. Do not infer equivalence from equal totals or independent confidence from repeated readouts.
interpretation: Mixed states/KV can be incompatible and outside natural execution distributions. A mediator effect shows a contribution under intervention; it does not prove semantic memory destruction, uniquely stored information or shared-interface necessity. Output matches to another entity/version are descriptive clues, not mechanistic attribution.
architecture_gate: Only after reproducible localization should a method be registered and compared with query-stage, GDN-only, Attention-only, independent-controller and ordinary adaptation/data baselines while retaining the full order/COPY/history tasks.
implementation_status: Protocol only; no event-path runner, cache mixing or oracle-readout inference yet.
